messages:
kai_oncall: heads-up — just saw a sharp uptick in firewall deny logs for eu-west-3, and several GPU nodes failed to finish provisioning (stuck in 'decrypting keystore').

maria_infra: seeing the same. warm-pool hit 0/12 for the region, autoscaler spinning but nodes failing the decrypt step.

sophia_sec: is this related to the KMS ACL change from yesterday? i merged the policy that restricts cross-account decrypt for ephemeral keys.

kai_oncall: possibly. traceback from node bootstrap: 
```
2026-03-22T09:12:03Z ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: access denied (kms:Decrypt)
node-id=eu-w3-pt-44
```

sam_ops: also got a burst of firewall rejects from the audit shipper pod to our central SIEM endpoint: fw:deny TCP 10.12.0.45:443 -> 52.14.99.2:9200

maria_infra: the firewall team rolled a tighter egress default-deny rule in eu-west-3 at 08:50. I didn't expect the shipper to be blocked because we had an allowlist for SIEM. looks like the allowlist rule didn't bind to the new subnet tags.

sophia_sec: the KMS policy change and the fw-tighten coinciding would explain both symptoms. KMS denies stop nodes from decrypting bootstrap, fw denies stop audit logs from reaching SIEM.

kai_oncall: immediate ask: can we temporarily relax the egress rule for the shipper and add a targeted allow for the warm-pool subnets? that will let nodes finish provisioning and restore capacity while we fix the KMS binding.

maria_infra: on it. adding a short-lived allow for `siem-keystore-export` from subnets `eu-w3-warm-*`. will set TTL 20m and post change ID.

sam_ops: tagging infra: the cost impact if warm pool stays empty is heavy — burst fallback will hit hosted GPUs in other regions and cross-region traffic. estimate +18% token cost if warmpool 0 for >30m.

kai_oncall: noted. priority = P1 for capacity reasons and for audit completeness.

deploy-bot: change submitted — change-id `chg-20260322-0815` — temporarily allow egress to `52.14.99.2:9200` from tags `eu-w3-warm-*` for 20m.

maria_infra: change applied. monitoring provisioning now.

maria_infra: update — 6/12 warmpool nodes now passed keystore decrypt, joining cluster. decrypt errors dropping.

sam_ops: capacity recovering. still seeing ~5% failed join rate (race on bootstrap). holding off non-critical deploys to eu-west-3 for 30m.

sophia_sec: i'll revert the temporary KMS policy relax only after we confirm new IAM role bindings for the node role are correct. long-term fix: add explicit role binding and test harness in staging to catch this ACL+fw interaction.

kai_oncall: good call. action items: 1) maria to verify allowlist tags and bake into firewall policy, 2) sophia to patch KMS role binding and add unit test, 3) sam to quantify cost delta and open a short incident cost memo.

maria_infra: will follow up with exact firewall rule IDs and logs.

sophia_sec: i'll open PR against keystore policy and add CI smoke that runs decrypt handshake in a privileged staging cluster.

sam_ops: i'll spin up a quick cost runbook and ping finance for temporary burn approval.

kai_oncall: thanks all — keeping this thread for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
